socfpga_noc_probe.h

NoC Probe hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Types
socfpga_noc_probe_block_t

Identifies the specific hardware subsystem or bridge targeted by the NoC Probe.  The System-on-Chip interconnect uses distributed probes to monitor distinct traffic domains independently.

Values
SOCFPGA_NOC_PROBE_CCU

Cache Coherent Unit. Monitors MPU/CPU cluster traffic.

SOCFPGA_NOC_PROBE_SOC2FPGA

HPS-to-FPGA bridge. Monitors transactions crossing into the fabric.

SOCFPGA_NOC_PROBE_IO

General IO block. Monitors standard peripheral traffic.

socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t

A raw capture of the Network-on-Chip error logging registers. When the NoC detects a firewall violation or unmapped address decode fault, it freezes the offending AXI transaction packet header into these registers for software diagnosis.

The fields map directly to the hardware ERRLOG registers, which contain packet metadata such as the exact AXI Address, Burst Length, Transaction ID, Opcode, and Route ID.

socfpga_noc_probe_read_id
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_read_id(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
*
core_id
)

Performs a diagnostic read of the NoC Probe's Core ID register. This is used to verify that the target IP block is present on the bus, clocked, and out of reset before attempting further configuration.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC probe instance.

core_id
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the 32-bit hardware identification code.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL.

socfpga_noc_probe_error_logger_enable
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_error_logger_enable(
uint32_t 
base_address,
bool 
enable
)

Configures the Main Control register of the NoC probe to arm or disarm the error capture hardware. When enabled, the probe actively snoops AXI traffic and will latch the first faulted packet it encounters into the ERRLOG registers.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

enable
bool

true to arm the error logger; false to bypass.

Returns

0 on success.

socfpga_noc_probe_error_is_valid
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_error_is_valid(
uint32_t 
base_address,
bool 
*
valid
)

Reads the Main Status register to determine if the hardware has trapped a faulted packet. If the valid bit is set, the ERRLOG registers contain frozen, uncorrupted data about the failing transaction.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

valid
bool*

Pointer to a boolean that will be set to true if an error is currently latched by the hardware.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL.

socfpga_noc_probe_error_read
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_error_read(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t 
*
log
)

Extracts the complete frozen packet header from the ERRLOG registers. This should only be called after socfpga_noc_probe_error_is_valid confirms a fault has been trapped.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

log
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t*

Pointer to the struct where the raw register contents will be written.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL.

socfpga_noc_probe_error_clear
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_error_clear(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Clears the valid latch in the Main Status register. This acknowledges the current fault to the hardware, clearing the ERRLOG registers and re-arming the probe to capture the next interconnect error.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

Returns

0 on success.

socfpga_noc_probe_counter_set_source
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_counter_set_source(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_probe_block_t 
block,
uint32_t 
counter,
uint32_t 
source
)

Multiplexes a specific interconnect event (such as byte transfer counts, idle cycles, or read/write transaction ticks) into one of the hardware's Performance Monitoring Unit (PMU) counters.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

block
socfpga_noc_probe_block_t

The specific interconnect block to monitor.

counter
uint32_t

The hardware index of the PMU counter to configure (e.g., 0, 1).

source
uint32_t

The hardware-specific event mask or route ID to track.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the counter index or block is out of bounds.

socfpga_noc_probe_counter_get_value
int32_t socfpga_noc_probe_counter_get_value(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_probe_block_t 
block,
uint32_t 
counter,
uint32_t 
*
value
)

Reads the live, accumulating value of the specified PMU counter. This is used to calculate bus utilization, bandwidth, or latency metrics over a specific software profiling window.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The MMIO base address of the target NoC probe instance.

block
socfpga_noc_probe_block_t

The specific interconnect block being monitored.

counter
uint32_t

The hardware index of the active PMU counter.

value
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the current 32-bit tick/event count.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL or the counter index is invalid.
